title: What's New: Concurrent Inventory Posting (2025 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Concurrent inventory posting overview and feature management
Project and resource ledgers, and legacy locking mechanism
Number sequences and item register drill-down design
Automatic cost posting and GL locking demonstration
Developer guidance and event handling for custom entries

features.name: Enable multiple users to post item ledger entries and value entries at the same time
features.description: New feature in BC25 wave 1 that allows concurrent posting to item and value ledger entries instead of serialized posting. Uses number sequences instead of table locking.
caveats: Will be set on by default in three releases
Backwards compatibility maintained with item register number filtering

features.name: Concurrent posting for project ledger entries
features.description: Same concurrent posting capability extended to project ledger and resource ledger entries following the same rules as item ledger concurrent posting.

features.name: Number sequence-based entry numbering for concurrent posting
features.description: Replaces table locking with number sequences to generate entry numbers, allowing multiple sessions to insert simultaneously. Uses get next entry number functions on entry tables.
caveats: Similar to bakery number dispenser model

features.name: Item register number field for drill-down filtering
features.description: New field added to ledger entries to track which register they belong to, enabling drill-down from item register to entries when from and to entry numbers overlap due to concurrent posting.
caveats: Zero value for backwards compatibility with old entries
Overlapping from and to numbers in registers

features.name: Deferred automatic cost posting to GL
features.description: Postpones GL posting from individual item journal lines until the end of the batch to prevent GL locking during inventory posting, allowing concurrent inventory operations while still maintaining GL integrity.
caveats: Users are still locked when posting to GL
Only one user can post to GL at a time
